note: The Muni (Lake Oswego) trace, course chat 2026-10-22. OSM maps only the city's golf property and the old driving range; the 2025 nine is not mapped. Green seeds picked by eye on the OSIP 2024 orthophoto (raw/osip2024_032m.tif; summer 2024, the new greens grown in). Hole identity from the 2021 site plan (release muni-data, LOGC_SITE.PLAN_5-19-21.pdf) and the city's course map (Screenshot 2026-10-22 122955), both look only; the plan was fitted to the greens by an affine (residuals 5-15 m). Each hole's provisional tee point lies the Black card distance back from the green towards the plan's tee. No tee pads from the DEM: the 2019 lidar predates the rebuild and shows the old par-3 course's tees. The practice putting green south of 9 (about 353, 321) is not a hole. Local metres, world origin (524034, 5026969), EPSG:32610. Hole 1's tee point is the turf patch west of the clubhouse (photo; the course map's tee rectangle is there). No fairways are proposed: the 2024 grow-in photo doesn't separate fairway from rough (a colour rule picked random patches), so the developer draws them in the desk.
